notification.name: New Notifications
notification.description: Play a short animation on the Glyphs whenever you have a new notification come in (this does not include calls).

unread.name: Unread Notifications
unread.description: Play a short animation on the Glyphs whenever you have an unread notification.

recording.name: Recording Light
recording.description: Preserve privacy and transparency by allowing an animation on your Glyphs whenever you record a video.

charging.name: Charging
charging.description: This animation plays whenever your phone is charging. Using the 'Fill' animation will actually show how much battery you have.

wireless_charging.name: Wireless Charging
wireless_charging.description: Play an animation while wireless charging. (This and the basic 'charging' animation will both play while wireless charging if both are enabled.)

call.name: Incoming Calls
call.description: Play an animation receiving an incoming call
